title: Project im working...
author: IllustriousDevice221
selftext:
So this started as a personal thing, I just wanted something for my own use.

TradingView is great but let's be real, it's not cheap. If you want multiple charts, a bunch of indicators and realtime CFD prices you're paying around $700 a year. That's crazy for an average trader.

I'm a dev so I thought screw it, I'll just build it myself. It ended up looking and working almost the same as TradingView, so I figured I'd share it.

It's open source, use it, fork it, break it, do whatever you want with it. Only thing I ask is if you get some free time, tell me what you think or what it does for you.

try when it free

[https://github.com/DimanthaBalasuriya/MuseCharts.git](https://github.com/DimanthaBalasuriya/MuseCharts.git)

comments.author: AcanthocephalaNo6605
comments.body:
TV will survive because there are lot of edge cases where vibe coded or fairly coded charts doesnt work. Eg: in tick by tick or custom range it will break. If you are showing crypto or any other markets its timing will affect chart and its canvas which will lead to drawing tool not working!

But kudos, if this is working for you product is worth pursuing.
